blocks.content: It's tempting to put everything into one big context. But merging unrelated states has a cost.
If both theme and entries lived in a single AppContext, every theme toggle would re-render every component that touches the context — even components that only care about entries.
On small apps the difference is invisible.
On real apps with dozens of consumers, those unnecessary re-renders compound across the component tree. Let's see what the alternative looks like.
